title: 6/11 delivered pick never entered in the MLB app; nothing alerted until the operator noticed the frozen streak on 6/12
tier_reason: entry/contest impact: the day's delivered pick was not entered in the contest, and no alert fired before or after the cutoff

contract.text: A delivered pick is entered in the BTS contest account before its cutoff; a delivered pick with no entry is surfaced to the operator before the cutoff.
contract.source: ARCHITECTURE.md 'bts check-pick-entered' ('Original incident: 2026-06-11, a delivered pick never entered — this closes that class'; 'Eric always intends the entered pick to equal the recommendation'); 4f13eb3 body

mechanism.text: the operator did not enter the delivered 6/11 pick in the MLB app (a manual step outside the system)
no job verified before the cutoff that the delivered pick was present in the contest account, so the missing entry was not flagged while it could still be fixed

code.symbol: installed cron jobs (no entry check; fetch-contest-streak only reads settled results)

mechanism.text: afterwards the contest fetch correctly refused the non-advancing observation, and contest_state health treated the resulting one-settled-pick gap as the expected overnight lag (INFO at any time of day), so nothing alerted until the operator noticed the frozen streak

code.symbol: check (gap == EXPECTED_OVERNIGHT_LAG_DAYS -> INFO regardless of time of day)

residual.text: The noon-ET contest_state WARN (the only part of the 6/12 fix that stayed live until v2) is not an attention WARN source, so it is logged but not DM'd, and it fires only after the cutoff.
residual.source: 4f13eb3 src/bts/health/attention.py + health/alert.py dispatch (CRITICAL + attention WARNs only); superseded for detection by check-pick-entered v2 (720651a)

residual.text: check-pick-entered skips quietly on any contest fetch/auth failure; if the contest API is unreachable through the whole pre-pitch window, a non-entry is surfaced only by the EOD pick_entry backstop, after the cutoff.
residual.source: ARCHITECTURE.md 'bts check-pick-entered' (v2/v3 marker discipline, 'Transient auth outages keep the quiet-skip')

watchdog.trigger: from T−30 minutes before the earliest selected game's cutoff (first pitch − 5 min), a scoreable delivered selection has no matching pending row in the contest account (api/predictions), re-checked every 15 minutes until the cutoff
watchdog.recovery_assertion: the contest account shows every delivered slot entered before the cutoff, or the operator records a deliberate non-entry; the day's contest result is then consistent with the local commit

evidence.what: a delivered pick was never entered in the MLB app; nothing alerted until Eric noticed the frozen streak a day later; the fetch path behaved correctly — no check existed for 'pick in the app at all'
the 2026-06-11 root cause: Eric didn't enter a delivered pick; everything else behaved correctly; the only surviving fix is the noon-ET WARN escalation
v1 check-pick-entered cron removed the same night (settled-only endpoint); the noon-ET WARN stands, which 'was correct for the 06-11 incident'

evidence.locator: commit 4f13eb3^ (1ba01c4) src/bts/health/contest_state.py check; health/attention.py + health/alert.py at 4f13eb3
evidence.what: before the fix a persisting one-day gap stayed INFO all day; the added noon WARN is not in the attention WARN sets, so the health DM (CRITICALs + attention WARNs) does not carry it
